title: PB&J (Peanut Butter and Strawberry Jam Sandwich)
summary: Smooth peanut butter spread thinly on all four slices of soft white bread, strawberry jam on two, then closed and cut on the diagonal. Ready in 5 minutes.

steps.title: Spread the peanut butter
steps.text: Spread the peanut butter thinly over all four slices, right to the edges. A layer on both sides acts as a seal, so the jam can't soak into the bread.

steps.title: Add the jam
steps.text: Spoon the jam onto two of the slices and spread it evenly, stopping about 5 mm from the crust so it doesn't squeeze out.

steps.title: Close and cut
steps.text: Close the sandwiches, press gently and cut each one in half on the diagonal. Eat straight away or wrap for a packed lunch.

tips: Crunchy peanut butter adds texture; raspberry or grape jam are classic swaps.
A tiny pinch of flaky salt on the jam sharpens the flavour.
Toast the finished sandwich in a dry pan for a warm, melting version.
storage: Wrapped, it keeps well at room temperature until lunchtime the same day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
